description: Portable demographic targeting intent plus buyer constraints on how the seller may determine user eligibility. The age predicate retains its canonical interval meaning; accepted_bases narrows execution provenance without changing which ages are requested.

allOf.description: A canonical audience-age predicate in completed integer years. min and max are inclusive; omitting one bound means no restriction in that direction. At least one bound is required. include_unknown is always explicit because people whose age is unavailable are not members of any numeric interval. Implementations MUST reject min greater than max; JSON Schema draft-07 cannot compare sibling numeric values.

include_unknown.description: Whether delivery to people whose age is unavailable is part of this predicate. This field has no default and MUST be supplied.

max.description: Inclusive maximum age in completed years. Omit for an open upper bound.

min.description: Inclusive minimum age in completed years. Omit for an open lower bound.

allOf.title: Demographic Age Range

accepted_bases.description: User-level age determination bases the buyer permits for this predicate. Sellers MUST use only these bases or reject the request; they MUST NOT silently fall back to another basis. When omitted, the buyer imposes no determination-basis constraint beyond product capability and any age_restriction. population_estimate is structurally unavailable because aggregate evidence cannot identify an eligible user.

items.description: User-level bases that may resolve age for demographic targeting execution. Population estimates are deliberately absent because aggregate composition cannot establish an individual impression's age.

enumDescriptions.declared: The user supplied an age, date of birth, or threshold affirmation without independent verification.
enumDescriptions.inferred: The user's age was predicted from behavior, attributes, or another model.
enumDescriptions.verified: The user's applicable age claim was established through an age-assurance or identity-verification method.

items.title: Age Determination Basis

accepted_verification_methods.description: Verification methods acceptable when verified is an accepted basis. This field narrows verified demographic execution; age_restriction.accepted_methods independently governs legal eligibility and the two sets are intersected when both are present.

items.description: Methods for verifying user age for compliance. Does not include 'inferred' as it is not accepted for regulatory compliance.
items.title: Age Verification Method

title: Demographic Targeting Intent
